title: Watching the AI Watchdogs: A Fairness and Robustness Analysis of AI Safety Moderation Classifiers
benchmark_measurement: Bias in content moderation classifiers when evaluating text containing religious terms or identities.
findings: The paper does not provide specific quantitative fairness metrics for religion as a distinct category. However, qualitative analysis through topic modeling reveals the prevalence of terms related to Christianity (e.g., church, god, catholic) and Islam (e.g., muslim, islam, islamic) within the datasets used to test the fairness and robustness of content moderation classifiers. Given the paper's general findings of fairness and robustness gaps in these classifiers, it implies that content involving religious themes is subject to the same identified vulnerabilities.
